bootstrap.unit: six source units resampled with replacement within each of three environments; four fresh targets kept together

gate_rules.G1: all three environment means >0 for both BP and MBD
gate_rules.G2: both pooled environment-source bootstrap 95% lower bounds >0, 10000 draws
gate_rules.G3: both >=13/18 positive source units and >=4/6 each environment
gate_rules.G4: both pooled 20% trim and remove largest positive 5% target mean >0
gate_rules.G5: FULL improves >=2/3 Brier, 1m mass, expected distance vs BP; none worsens >5% in any environment
gate_rules.G6: no environment FULL mean truth NLL >1.10*BP or >1.10*MBD

model_contract.BP: five separate source-specific 2D sklearn OAS with G0 jitter
model_contract.DIAG: source-specific 10D OAS then diagonalize before G0 jitter
model_contract.FULL: source-specific 10D sklearn OAS, original G0 jitter
model_contract.MBD: FULL stabilized covariance block diagonal; exact FULL mean; no OAS refit or second jitter
model_contract.pca: 2 per block, full solver, reference only
